title: Dick Clark, pressing plant deals and payola
summary: How Clanton's TV appearances worked with Dick Clark's manager and pressing interest, then how larger labels escalated promotion into the payola scandal, with Alan Freed as fall guy.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
